children.title: Disconnected graphs are reconstructible
children.statement_en: Every disconnected graph on at least 3 vertices is reconstructible (Kelly 1957).

children.title: Self- and co-connected graphs with a dominating edge or diameter at most 2 in both G and its complement are reconstructible
children.statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices such that G and its complement are both connected, and either G has a dominating edge (an edge uv such that every vertex equals u or v or is adjacent to u or v) or every pair of vertices has distance at most 2 both in G and in its complement, is reconstructible. (Aravind-Monikandan arXiv:2601.00620 Lemma 4, UNVERIFIED; notes/literature/structural_reductions.md C3/C4.)
children.statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => G.Connected ∧ Gᶜ.Connected ∧ ((∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ ∀ x : Fin n, x = u ∨ x = v ∨ G.Adj x u ∨ G.Adj x v) ∨ ∀ u v : Fin n, G.edist u v ≤ 2 ∧ Gᶜ.edist u v ≤ 2))
